newsitem.title: USA: Dow hits record high for 8th straight session.
newsitem.headline: Dow hits record high for 8th straight session.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average hit a record for the eighth consecutive session Friday, boosted by buy programmes and continued optimism about the economy.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow rose 35.03 points to 6,348.03, beating Thursday's record of 6,313.00 and surpassing the string of seven straight records set in February.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 12-11 on very heavy volume of 528 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
